notes: WA Firearm Safety Training Course, Part 1 theory assessment (CRTAFE, online), required since 31 March 2025 by the Firearms Act 2024 (WA) s 166 and Firearms Regulations 2024 r 224 for first-time firearm authority applicants and authorised persons; it replaced the Firearm Awareness Test of the repealed Firearms Act 1973 and Firearms Regulations 1974. Real assessment: 40 questions drawn at random from a bank, at least 80% overall across three sections (WA Police information sheet). Five 40-question tests at 80% model it. Topic weights are not published; split is Tigertest's: WA law 31 (licences 5, hunting permissions 5, eligibility 5, categories and ammunition 5, storage and transit 6, conduct and reporting 5) and safe use 9 (possession, care and actions 5, ranges, field and young shooters 4) of 40.
